name: Muffler
summary: The box near the back of the exhaust that makes the engine quieter.
whatItDoes: It brings the exhaust noise down to a comfortable, legal level.
howItWorks: Exhaust gas leaves the engine in loud pulses. Inside the muffler, chambers, perforated tubes and sound-absorbing packing make those pulses bounce around, cancel each other out and lose energy before the gas leaves through the tailpipe.
failureSymptoms: Exhaust smell inside the car (dangerous: get it checked straight away)
safetyNotes: Exhaust fumes contain carbon monoxide. Never run the engine in a closed garage.
Wait for the exhaust to cool before touching it.
